Body.Content:
Keeps project billing milestone dates consistent regardless of the signed-in user's local time zone. Using time zone independent milestone dates on quote and contract records helps globally distributed teams work from the same billing date and reduces date discrepancies when exchanging milestone information with finance systems.

GA date: February CY2027
